description.en: The domain name of the Visual Edge Computing Service.

description.zh:
结束时间需大于起始时间；获日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间。
格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
description.en:
The end time must be later than the start time. Use ISO8601 notation for the date format and UTC time.
Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

description.zh: 查询数据的时间粒度，支持300, 3600和86400秒。不传和传的值不支持时，使用默认值300秒
description.en: The time granularity for querying data. Supported values are 300, 3600, and 86400 seconds. If this parameter is not provided or an unsupported value is passed, the default value of 300 seconds is used.

description.zh: 运营商英文名。通过DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp接口获得，不传该参数代表查询所有运营商。
description.en: The English name of the ISP. Obtain this value through the DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp interface. If this parameter is not provided, the system queries all ISPs.

description.zh: 区域英文名。通过DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp接口获得，不传该参数代表查询所有区域。
description.en: The English name of the region. Obtain this value through the DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp interface. If this parameter is not provided, the system queries all regions.

description.zh:
获取数据起始时间点，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间。
格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
最小数据粒度为5分钟
不写默认读取过去24小时数据
description.en:
The start time for data retrieval. Use ISO8601 notation for the date format and UTC time.
Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
The minimum data granularity is 5 minutes.
If not specified, the system reads data from the past 24 hours by default.
